perks.name: Blade Familiarity
perks.description: -10% blade attack stamina cost.

perks.name: Drawing Blood
perks.description: direct light blade hits have a 25% chance to cause bleeding; direct heavy blade hits guarantee an application on bleed-susceptible targets. One wound deals 20% of its originating attack's pre-armor damage over six seconds, maximum one wound per attacker/target until Deep Wound is purchased. Two-second application cooldown; a replacement wound does not immediately pay out remaining damage. This is the shared bleed mechanic for ALL blade builds. In implementation, integrate native bleeding visuals/status recognition but use one authoritative damage path; do not also grant inherited knife bleed. This replaces the former Guarded Footwork fundamental; that defensive effect is now provided only by Sentinel mastery. The fundamental count stays at two.

perks.name: Quick Hands
perks.description: +10% blade attack speed.

perks.name: Precision
perks.description: successive direct hits on the same target add +5% blade damage per stack, maximum three, lasting four seconds after the latest qualifying hit. A different target or hostile damage taken clears the old stacks.

perks.name: Measured Strike
perks.description: a heavy hit at three Precision stacks consumes them for +30% damage and 20 points of armor penetration on that hit. The triggering hit does not also generate a new stack; four-second activation cooldown.

perks.name: Perfect Rhythm
perks.description: Precision lasts six seconds; Measured Strike leaves one stack instead of zero. Hostile damage still clears stacks.

perks.name: Powerful Cuts
perks.description: +20% heavy blade attack damage.

perks.name: Momentum
perks.description: blade kills grant -15% blade stamina cost and +10% movement speed for six seconds. Subsequent kills refresh, rather than stack, this buff.

perks.name: Blood Rush
perks.description: blade kills restore eight stamina. While Momentum is already active, a kill adds two seconds, with ten seconds maximum remaining duration; this replaces the basic six-second refresh behavior during that active buff.

perks.name: Relentless Cuts
perks.description: while Momentum is active, gain +15% heavy blade damage and ten physical armor rating. Armor remains subject to normal mitigation limits.

perks.name: Exploit Opening
perks.description: +20% blade damage to unaware, staggered or knocked-down targets. Meeting several conditions still applies the bonus only once.

perks.name: Deep Wound
perks.description: improves Drawing Blood to three independent wounds per attacker/target. Light hits meeting Exploit Opening's conditions now guarantee a wound, too. The existing two-second application cooldown remains shared. This upgrades the SAME bleed, not a second application on the same hit. Applying a fourth replaces the oldest wound. No damage-on-replacement payout.

perks.name: Find the Gap
perks.description: direct blade hits against bleeding targets ignore 15 armor.

perks.name: Executioner
perks.description: +30% direct blade damage against targets below 30% health immediately before the hit. This is bonus damage, not an instant-kill rule.

perks.name: Perfect Form
perks.description: +10% blade damage and a further -10% blade stamina cost.

perks.name: Master Duelist
perks.description: Precision maximum becomes five stacks; Measured Strike still requires/consumes three, leaves at least one through Perfect Rhythm, and gains +50% bonus damage instead of +30%. Spare stacks are retained.

perks.name: Unrelenting
perks.description: Blood Rush restores 12 stamina instead of eight; Momentum can reach 15 seconds remaining rather than ten.

perks.name: Death by a Thousand Cuts
perks.description: each Deep Wound deals 30% rather than 20%; Executioner triggers below 40% health rather than 30%. Wound limit/cooldown stay unchanged.

perks.name: Sentinel
perks.description: direct blade hits grant Guarded Footwork: 20% physical damage reduction for four seconds, six-second activation cooldown. No stacking or refresh during cooldown. This supplies the defensive effect removed from the fundamentals.

perks.name: Spellblade
perks.description: a direct wand/staff hit primes the next direct blade hit within six seconds for +25% damage. That blade hit primes the next direct wand/staff hit within six seconds for +25% damage. Empowerment never stacks; secondary damage cannot prime it; the wand/staff still requires ammunition and follows normal conservation rules. No free spell proc. Only a tool family at proficiency 40 qualifies; Totems does not qualify.

perks.name: Heavy Grip
perks.description: -10% blunt attack stamina cost.

perks.name: Crushing Impact
perks.description: +20% stagger strength on direct blunt attacks. This improves an attack's stagger effect; it is not a flat 20-percentage-point stun chance.

perks.name: Breaker
perks.description: +20% heavy blunt attack damage against targets with positive armor.

perks.name: Sunder
perks.description: direct heavy hits reduce target armor by five for eight seconds, maximum three stacks. New hits refresh the stack duration. Across a party, the strongest Sunder stack set applies; attackers do not add duplicate sets.

perks.name: Fracture
perks.description: each Sunder stack becomes eight armor reduction and lasts ten seconds; maximum remains three stacks. Armor cannot be reduced below zero.

perks.name: Shatter
perks.description: +25% heavy blunt damage against targets carrying three Sunder stacks. Evaluate stacks before the hit; the hit adding stack three does not receive this bonus yet.

perks.name: Brawler
perks.description: +10% light blunt attack speed.

perks.name: Cleaving Blow
perks.description: a direct heavy hit also deals 35% of that attack's pre-armor damage to up to two additional nearby hostiles in the forward melee arc. Each secondary target applies its own mitigation. Three-second cooldown.

perks.name: Rampage
perks.description: hitting at least two enemies with Cleaving Blow grants -15% blunt stamina cost for six seconds; refreshes, does not stack.

perks.name: Crushing Sweep
perks.description: secondary Cleaving Blow damage becomes 50% instead of 35%. Cleave adds a normal stagger attempt to secondary targets; respects immunity.

perks.name: Brace
perks.description: landing a direct heavy blunt hit grants 10% physical damage reduction for three seconds, with six seconds between activations.

perks.name: Retaliation
perks.description: hostile damage taken during Brace empowers the next direct blunt hit within four seconds for +25% damage and +25% stagger strength. Only one charge; six-second activation cooldown; repeated hits cannot stack it.

perks.name: Stand Firm
perks.description: Brace additionally grants 25% resistance to stagger/knockback.

perks.name: Immovable
perks.description: Brace lasts four seconds and provides 20% physical damage reduction rather than 10%. Its six-second activation cooldown remains.

perks.name: Titan's Strength
perks.description: +10% blunt damage and a further -10% blunt stamina cost.

perks.name: Shattering Blow
perks.description: Fracture stacks reduce armor by ten rather than eight; Shatter's heavy-hit bonus becomes +35% rather than +25%.

perks.name: Unstoppable Force
perks.description: Cleaving Blow can hit three additional enemies rather than two; secondary damage becomes 65%; three-second cooldown remains.

perks.name: Mountain Stance
perks.description: Brace lasts five seconds; Retaliation grants +40% damage instead of +25%. Six-second activation cooldowns remain.

perks.name: Battle Smith
perks.description: -30% blunt weapon durability loss and +15% blunt heavy-attack damage. No inventory duplication or unimplemented permanent item-quality modifier is required.

perks.name: Polearm Familiarity
perks.description: -10% polearm stamina cost.

perks.name: Crippling Thrust
perks.description: direct heavy polearm hits have a 40% chance to apply the native spear cripple. One roll per hit on an eligible living hostile. This is shared across every polearm branch. Additional control rolls never multiply the slow.

perks.name: Point Control
perks.description: +20% direct polearm damage in the long-range zone.

perks.name: Piercing Thrust
perks.description: long-range direct hits ignore 20 armor.

perks.name: Through the Ranks
perks.description: a heavy thrust can damage one additional enemy directly behind the primary target for 50% of the originating attack's pre-armor damage. Maximum weapon reach, line of sight and three-second secondary-hit cooldown.

perks.name: Exploit the Limp
perks.description: +25% direct heavy-hit damage against crippled targets. Existing native cripple applied by an ally also qualifies.

perks.name: Set Your Feet
perks.description: after remaining within a half-metre radius for one second, heavy polearm attacks gain +25% stagger strength. Leaving the radius resets it.

perks.name: Intercept
perks.description: +30% direct damage against a hostile moving toward you that entered your weapon reach within the last two seconds. Once per target every six seconds. Moving toward a stationary enemy yourself is not an interception.

perks.name: Braced Guard
perks.description: a successful Intercept grants 15% physical damage reduction for four seconds. Moving over 1.5 metres from the activation point ends it. Six-second activation cooldown; not a new shield or blocking action.

perks.name: Halt the Advance
perks.description: Intercept guarantees a native cripple application on an eligible target and makes a normal stagger attempt. This replaces, rather than adds to, Crippling Thrust's chance for that hit. Immunities remain effective.

perks.name: Clear Space
perks.description: +10% backward walking speed while actively holding a polearm; no sprint multiplier or backwards speed exceeding normal forward movement.

perks.name: Sweeping Reach
perks.description: a direct heavy attack also hits up to two secondary enemies in the forward melee arc for 35% pre-armor damage each. Three-second cooldown.

perks.name: Hamstring Sweep
perks.description: those secondary hits each have a 40% chance to apply the native spear cripple. This is an explicit secondary-effect exception; it cannot recursively trigger another sweep, thrust or other on-hit perk.

perks.name: Fighting Withdrawal
perks.description: a direct hit against a crippled enemy grants +15% movement speed and -15% polearm stamina cost for six seconds; eight-second activation cooldown. Repositioning, rather than staying in contact, is rewarded.

perks.name: Perfect Measure
perks.description: +10% polearm damage and a further -10% polearm stamina cost.

perks.name: Master Lancer
perks.description: Point Control becomes +35% instead of +20%; Through the Ranks' secondary damage becomes 75% instead of 50%.

perks.name: Unbroken Line
perks.description: Braced Guard grants 25% reduction rather than 15%; Intercept's per-target cooldown falls from six to four seconds. Guard cooldown stays six.

perks.name: Field Marshal
perks.description: Sweeping Reach hits up to three secondary enemies rather than two; Hamstring Sweep's application chance becomes 60% rather than 40%.

perks.name: Conditioned Hands
perks.description: -10% unarmed attack stamina cost.

perks.name: Combination
perks.description: the first direct unarmed hit grants one Combo. Alternating light and heavy direct hits adds one, up to three. The next successful heavy hit after reaching three spends all three for +25% damage: a Finisher. A finisher does not also build Combo. Combo lasts four seconds after a hit that actually adds a point. Repeating the same attack does not add or refresh points; a missed attack or switching away from unarmed clears the combination. Taking damage does not clear Combo. A finisher uses ordinary heavy-attack stamina cost, not a second resource cost. No new animation/button is required.

perks.name: Quick Jabs
perks.description: +10% light unarmed attack speed.

perks.name: Body Blows
perks.description: +15% heavy unarmed damage.

perks.name: Follow Through
perks.description: Combo duration increases from four to six seconds.

perks.name: Flurry
perks.description: completing a finisher grants +15% unarmed attack speed for four seconds; six-second activation cooldown, no stacking.

perks.name: Fleet Foot
perks.description: a direct unarmed hit grants +10% movement speed for three seconds; five-second activation cooldown.

perks.name: Slip Away
perks.description: a finisher grants 15% physical damage reduction for three seconds. Five-second activation cooldown; no invulnerability or perfect-dodge input.

perks.name: Re-entry
perks.description: move at least three metres on foot between consecutive successful unarmed hits, within four seconds, to give the returning hit +20% damage. Five-second activation cooldown. Teleports, mounts and forced displacement do not count; track voluntary horizontal movement, not jumping in place.

perks.name: Flowing Step
perks.description: Fleet Foot becomes +15% movement speed with a three-second cooldown, allowing sustained mobility when you keep landing hits.

perks.name: Pressure Points
perks.description: +20% unarmed heavy-attack stagger strength.

perks.name: Interrupting Finish
perks.description: finishers make a normal stagger attempt against eligible enemies, with an eight-second per-target control cooldown. This may interrupt a staggerable attack; it does not guarantee cancelling every boss animation.

perks.name: Unbalance
perks.description: finishers reduce the target's outgoing melee damage by 15% for three seconds. Refresh, never stack, across all attackers. Requires a targeted damage modifier; this is a proposed new effect, not native spear cripple.

perks.name: Punish the Opening
perks.description: direct unarmed hits against Unbalanced targets gain +25% damage. An ally's Unbalance also qualifies; its damage bonus applies once.

perks.name: Perfect Technique
perks.description: +10% unarmed damage and a further -10% stamina cost.

perks.name: Master Pugilist
perks.description: Combo finisher bonus becomes +50% instead of +25%; a successful finisher leaves one Combo instead of zero and starts a fresh normal Combo timer.

perks.name: Wind Dancer
perks.description: Fleet Foot becomes +20% movement speed for four seconds; Slip Away lasts four seconds rather than three. Existing activation cooldowns remain.

perks.name: Disarming Presence
perks.description: Unbalance becomes -20% outgoing melee damage for five seconds. This is a damage debuff; it does not remove weapons or disable arms.

perks.name: Archer's Handling
perks.description: +10% arrow and bolt projectile velocity. This is not an extra damage multiplier or automatic extension of the weapon's maximum hit range.

perks.name: Careful Handling
perks.description: -15% bow/crossbow durability loss per shot.

perks.name: Quick Draw
perks.description: +15% bow draw/loading speed. This reduces the preparation time between ordinary shots; it is not a second attack-speed multiplier applied to the same animation. Exact mapping to the native bow cycle needs verification.

perks.name: Fleet Archer
perks.description: +15% movement speed while aiming a bow, capped at the character's normal forward walking speed. No sprinting at full speed with a drawn bow.

perks.name: Rapid Rhythm
perks.description: a direct bow hit grants +10% bow draw/loading speed for five seconds, stacking three times (+30%). Further hits refresh the duration. A missed bow shot or switching away from bows clears Rhythm. Target switching does not clear it. One stack per fired arrow, never per damaged target.

perks.name: Running Shot
perks.description: voluntarily moving at least three metres on foot between bow shots primes the next shot within five seconds for +25% direct damage. The shot consumes the charge even if it misses. Five-second activation cooldown. Aiming movement counts; mounts, teleportation and forced movement do not.

perks.name: Practiced Loading
perks.description: +15% crossbow reload speed.

perks.name: Braced Shot
perks.description: aiming a loaded crossbow while remaining within a half-metre radius for one second primes a shot for +25% direct damage. Firing, stopping aim or leaving that radius clears the charge. No extra brace key is needed.

perks.name: Piercing Bolt
perks.description: direct crossbow hits ignore 20 armor. This does not penetrate walls or additional enemies and does not require a specific ammunition recipe.

perks.name: Decisive Bolt
perks.description: a Braced Shot hitting a recognized weak point gains another +30% direct damage. This adds to Braced Shot rather than multiplying it twice. A target with no recognized weak point still takes normal Braced Shot damage.

perks.name: Anatomist
perks.description: +20% direct arrow/bolt damage on a recognized weak-point hit. Use native head/weak-point metadata where available, not a new limb model.

perks.name: Specialized Payloads
perks.description: ammunition's authored bleed/burn damage totals gain +25%; ammunition's authored slow duration gains +25%. This does not create an effect on ordinary ammunition, increase direct damage, widen area of effect, increase slow strength, or grant a missing recipe. Every eligible damage effect is scaled once, not again on each tick. This excludes secondary explosives and instant payload damage until those ammo families are explicitly designed.

perks.name: Mark the Quarry
perks.description: a direct weak-point hit marks that enemy for six seconds. Your subsequent direct Archery hits against it gain +10% damage. The applying hit does not benefit from the new mark. Reapplication refreshes the duration. Marks are attacker-owned, do not multiply across the party, and do not provide wall vision, a guaranteed hit, or damage credit to someone else's projectile.

perks.name: Exploit Weakness
perks.description: +25% direct Archery damage against a target already bleeding, burning or movement-slowed immediately before impact. Several conditions still grant the bonus only once. An ally's effect can qualify. A projectile applying its first debuff does not immediately receive the bonus for its own new debuff.

perks.name: Perfect Aim
perks.description: +10% Archery damage and another +10% projectile velocity.

perks.name: Windrunner
perks.description: Rapid Rhythm can stack five times (+50% rather than +30% draw speed); Fleet Archer becomes +25% aimed movement rather than +15%, retaining its normal walking-speed cap. Missing still breaks the rhythm.

perks.name: Siegebreaker
perks.description: Braced Shot becomes +35% damage rather than +25%; Piercing Bolt ignores 30 armor rather than 20. Decisive Bolt retains its separate +30% bonus.

perks.name: Master Fletcher
perks.description: Specialized Payloads gives +50% bleed/burn damage and +50% slow duration instead of +25%. Existing effect immunities/duration caps apply. This mastery improves use of ammunition; it does not bypass crafting expertise.

perks.name: Wand Familiarity
perks.description: +10% wand reload speed.

perks.name: Steady Focus
perks.description: -15% wand durability consumption.

perks.name: Measured Bolt
perks.description: +10% direct wand damage.

perks.name: Arcane Lock
perks.description: consecutive direct hits on the same target build +5% damage per stack, maximum three, lasting four seconds refreshed by a hit. The current hit uses existing stacks, then adds one. Miss, different target or weapon switch clears stacks; taking damage does not. Resolve shots in firing order.

perks.name: Piercing Focus
perks.description: direct hits ignore 15% of target armor.

perks.name: Concentrated Power
perks.description: against a target already at three Arcane Lock stacks, gain +20% direct damage and another 10 percentage points of armor penetration.

perks.name: Agile Focus
perks.description: +15% aiming movement speed, capped at normal walking speed.

perks.name: Running Current
perks.description: after moving at least two metres under your own control within two seconds, gain +15% wand firing speed for three seconds; refreshable.

perks.name: Evasive Spark
perks.description: a direct hit grants 10% movement speed for three seconds; six-second cooldown, no stacking. Sprint still costs its normal stamina.

perks.name: Slipstream
perks.description: while Evasive Spark is active, gain 15% incoming damage reduction and another 10 percentage points of aiming movement speed, still walk-capped.

perks.name: Swift Casting
perks.description: +15% wand firing speed.

perks.name: Quick Recharge
perks.description: +20% wand reload speed.

perks.name: Efficient Channel
perks.description: +10 percentage points of wand ammunition conservation.

perks.name: Reservoir Release
perks.description: completing a reload that actually loads ammunition primes the next three shots within eight seconds for +20% damage. Each fired shot consumes one charge even on a miss or conserved ammunition; no charge stacking.

perks.name: Archwand
perks.description: +10% wand damage and +15% reload speed.

perks.name: Duelist's Focus
perks.description: Arcane Lock holds five stacks instead of three, lasts six seconds; Concentrated Power still activates at three existing stacks.

perks.name: Spellrunner
perks.description: Evasive Spark lasts five seconds instead of three; Agile Focus becomes +25% instead of +15%, subject to the same movement cap.

perks.name: Living Battery
perks.description: Reservoir Release empowers five shots instead of three; Efficient Channel becomes +15 conservation points instead of +10.

perks.name: Staff Familiarity
perks.description: +10% staff reload speed.

perks.name: Reinforced Conduit
perks.description: -15% staff durability consumption.

perks.name: Overload
perks.description: +15% staff damage, including its authored splash.

perks.name: Shaped Blast
perks.description: +20% explosion radius on ammunition that already has an area.

perks.name: Saturation
perks.description: +20% splash damage against secondary targets, excluding the primary impact target. This does not invent splash on single-target ammo.

perks.name: Rolling Thunder
perks.description: a blast damaging at least three living enemies primes the next staff shot within eight seconds for +25% damage. One stored charge; consume before resolving the next shot, which can earn a new charge.

perks.name: Focused Impact
perks.description: +15% damage to the primary impact target.

perks.name: Core Piercer
perks.description: primary impact ignores 20% armor; splash does not inherit this.

perks.name: Deep Reserve
perks.description: +1 loaded core capacity; it must be filled with real ammunition.

perks.name: Full Discharge
perks.description: completing a reload that adds ammunition primes the next staff shot within eight seconds for +30% primary-target damage. One charge; expended on firing even on a miss, never stacked by repeated reloads.

perks.name: Shock Front
perks.description: +25% stagger strength where a staff payload already supports it.

perks.name: Impeding Blast
perks.description: staff damage slows eligible enemies by 20% for three seconds. Boss immunities apply; strongest movement slow wins rather than adding slows.

perks.name: Grounded Casting
perks.description: after standing still for one second with a staff equipped, gain 15% incoming damage reduction until moving or switching tools.

perks.name: Repulsive Wave
perks.description: direct impact on an enemy already under Impeding Blast deals +20% primary-target damage and attempts one stronger stagger, at most once per target per six seconds. No guaranteed boss stun or chained knockdown.

perks.name: Grand Conduit
perks.description: +10% staff damage and +15% reload speed.

perks.name: Stormcaller
perks.description: Shaped Blast becomes +35% radius instead of +20%; Rolling Thunder requires two enemies instead of three.

perks.name: Siegecaster
perks.description: Deep Reserve grants two extra loaded cores instead of one; Full Discharge becomes +45% primary-target damage instead of +30%.

perks.name: Earthshaker
perks.description: Impeding Blast lasts five seconds instead of three; Grounded Casting activates after half a second rather than one second.

perks.name: Ritual Familiarity
perks.description: +10% totem reload speed.

perks.name: Spirit Attunement
perks.description: +10% totem healing and damage-over-time amounts.

perks.name: Mending Current
perks.description: +15% totem healing.

perks.name: Urgent Renewal
perks.description: healing ticks on a recipient below 40% health receive +25% healing, evaluated before each tick rather than snapshot for the whole ritual.

perks.name: Renewing Shelter
perks.description: effective totem healing grants the recipient +10 armor for four seconds, refreshable but not stackable; ordinary armor cap applies.

perks.name: Shared Renewal
perks.description: a single-target healing ritual echoes to one other injured permitted ally within four metres and line of sight for 50% healing. A self-cast may echo to an ally; no extra ammo, no echo of an echo or AoE echo.

perks.name: Lasting Wards
perks.description: +25% beneficial non-healing buff duration.

perks.name: Potent Wards
perks.description: +25% magnitude of authored beneficial numerical buffs, excluding healing, duration, invulnerability and new effects. Native caps still apply.

perks.name: Sheltering Rite
perks.description: applying a useful beneficial ritual grants its recipient 10% incoming damage reduction for four seconds, with an eight-second cooldown per recipient shared across casters. No stacking or refresh during cooldown.

perks.name: Shared Sanctuary
perks.description: single-target beneficial non-healing rituals echo to one other permitted ally within four metres and line of sight at full strength and half duration. No recursive or already-area echoes; no second ammo cost.

perks.name: Lingering Malice
perks.description: +20% totem damage-over-time amount, with unchanged duration.

perks.name: Binding Hex
perks.description: +25% duration of pure debuffs, excluding damaging/healing effects.

perks.name: Exploit Weakness
perks.description: totem DoT ticks deal +20% damage against targets carrying that caster's active pure totem debuff. Evaluate eligibility on each tick.

perks.name: Spreading Blight
perks.description: single-target harmful rituals echo to one other hostile within four metres and line of sight. DoT echoes have 50% total damage at full duration; pure debuffs retain full strength at half duration. No recursion or already-area echoes; no additional ammo. Mixed payloads scale each component.

perks.name: Ritualist
perks.description: a useful helpful cast empowers the next harmful cast, and vice versa, within eight seconds: +25% healing/DoT amount or +25% pure buff/debuff duration. One charge; consume on casting, no stacking. A useful empowered cast may prime the opposite. Ticks and echoes never independently prime it.

perks.name: Spiritkeeper
perks.description: Shared Renewal echoes to two other allies instead of one; additionally +15% totem healing, including self-healing.

perks.name: Sanctuary Keeper
perks.description: Shared Sanctuary echoes to two other allies instead of one; Sheltering Rite lasts six seconds instead of four, retaining its cooldown.

perks.name: Hexweaver
perks.description: Spreading Blight echoes to two other enemies instead of one; additionally +15% totem DoT damage.

perks.name: Fitted Plate
perks.description: reduce matching armor movement/stamina penalties by another 10%.

perks.name: Durable Metalwork
perks.description: matching pieces lose 20% less durability from incoming hits.

perks.name: Reinforced Plating
perks.description: +10 physical armor rating, subject to the normal cap.

perks.name: Set Your Feet
perks.description: standing still for one second grants 10% incoming hit damage reduction; ends on movement. Being forced out of position ends the stance.

perks.name: Impact Bracing
perks.description: reduce duration of hostile stagger/stun effects on you by 25%. No immunity, and no claimed reduction of ragdoll physics without implementation.

perks.name: Hold the Line
perks.description: while Set Your Feet is active, incoming hostile hits build 3% hit damage reduction each, up to 9%; six-second refreshed duration. This is added to that stance's 10%, not a second independently multiplying effect. Leaving the stance clears stacks. Current hit uses stacks already present.

perks.name: March of Iron
perks.description: another 20% reduction of heavy armor movement/stamina penalties.

perks.name: Driving Weight
perks.description: after moving two metres under your own control within two seconds, your next melee hit within three seconds gains +15% damage. Six-second cooldown starts on priming; one charge, expires unused, no secondary procs.

perks.name: Unbroken Advance
perks.description: hostile movement slows have 25% less duration; does not remove injuries, traps, encumbrance or scripted immobilization.

perks.name: Retaliating Force
perks.description: a hostile hit primes your next direct melee hit within four seconds for +25% damage and stagger strength. Six-second cooldown; one charge.

perks.name: Deep Reserves
perks.description: +20 maximum stamina; equipping does not refill current stamina.

perks.name: Second Wind
perks.description: when a hostile hit leaves you alive below 40% health, recover 20 stamina over four seconds. Thirty-second cooldown; no self-damage trigger.

perks.name: Field Recovery
perks.description: +20% effective healing received from medicine or magic.

perks.name: Last Bastion
perks.description: a hostile hit that leaves you alive below 25% health grants 25% incoming hit damage reduction for five seconds; 45-second cooldown. Applies after the triggering hit; cannot prevent an already lethal hit.

perks.name: Ironclad
perks.description: Reinforced Plating grants +15 armor instead of +10; Fitted Plate penalty reduction becomes 20% instead of 10%.

perks.name: Living Fortress
perks.description: Set Your Feet activates in half a second; Hold the Line permits five stacks (15%) instead of three (9%).

perks.name: Unstoppable
perks.description: Driving Weight lasts five seconds and grants +25% instead of +15% melee damage; Retaliating Force cooldown becomes four seconds instead of six.

perks.name: Deathless Resolve
perks.description: Last Bastion lasts eight seconds instead of five; Second Wind restores 30 stamina instead of 20. This grants no resurrection/immunity.

perks.name: Supple Fit
perks.description: reduce matching armor movement/stamina penalties by another 10%.

perks.name: Layered Hides
perks.description: matching pieces lose 20% less durability from incoming hits.

perks.name: Easy Stride
perks.description: sprinting costs 10% less stamina.

perks.name: Moving Guard
perks.description: after moving two metres under your own control within two seconds, gain 10% incoming hit damage reduction for two seconds; refreshable.

perks.name: Catch Your Breath
perks.description: after two seconds without attacking or sprinting, gain +25% stamina regeneration until attacking or sprinting again. Walking allowed.

perks.name: Flowing Battle
perks.description: a direct weapon hit while Moving Guard is active refunds five stamina, at most once every two seconds; never on echoes, splash or ticks.

perks.name: Ready Footwork
perks.description: +10% aiming movement speed, capped at ordinary walking speed.

perks.name: Rolling Recovery
perks.description: a hostile hit grants +10% movement speed for three seconds; eight-second cooldown. No dodge-roll mechanic or invulnerability is assumed.

perks.name: Counterstep
perks.description: Rolling Recovery primes the next direct weapon hit within four seconds for +20% damage. One charge; inherits Rolling Recovery's cooldown.

perks.name: Reversal

perks.name: Trail Recovery

perks.name: Open Channels

perks.name: Gentle Conduit

perks.name: Free Spirit
perks.description: Fleet Step grants +8% movement speed instead of +5%; Quiet Weave reduces armor movement noise by 35% instead of 20%.

perks.name: Windwalker

perks.name: Spellward

perks.name: Clear Conduit
perks.description: Clear Mind activates after two undamaged seconds instead of three; Gentle Conduit grants +25% totem healing instead of +15%.

perks.name: Extra Pouches
perks.description: +3 unencumbered slots.

perks.name: Opening Strike

perks.name: Exploit Surprise

perks.name: Ghostwalker
perks.description: another +15% crouched movement speed; Careful Hands reduces noise by 50% instead of 30%.

perks.name: Living Shadow
perks.description: Stillness activates after one second; Broken Trail reduces search duration by 40% instead of 25%, still only after line of sight is lost.

perks.name: Ambusher

perks.name: Tireless

perks.name: Long Stride

perks.name: Sure Landing

perks.name: Spring Step

perks.name: Bounding Pace
perks.description: a voluntary jump landing while moving grants +10% ground speed for three seconds; six-second cooldown. Not triggered by falls, knockback or stepping down a stair. Fall damage still applies where appropriate.

perks.name: Strong Stroke
perks.description: +15% swimming speed.

perks.name: Controlled Breathing
perks.description: +30% underwater breath duration; no breath refill on swap.

perks.name: Efficient Stroke
perks.description: swimming costs another 20% less stamina.

perks.name: Shorebound
perks.description: after at least three seconds of actual swimming, leaving water grants +20% stamina regeneration and 15% cheaper sprinting for six seconds; 15-second cooldown. Wading and repeated waterline bobbing do not qualify.

perks.name: Tireless Traveler

perks.name: Windstrider

perks.name: Surefoot

perks.name: Abundant Rows

perks.name: Gatherer's Eye

perks.name: Wild Bounty

perks.name: Efficient Gathering

perks.name: Trail Pantry

perks.name: Clean Butchery
perks.description: +15% meat/fat yield from eligible animal remains.

perks.name: Trail Reader

perks.name: Full Use

perks.name: Field Dressing

perks.name: Homesteader

perks.name: Hearty Portions

perks.name: Efficient Kitchen
perks.description: meal recipes use 10% fewer common food ingredients.

perks.name: Balanced Plate

perks.name: Fortifying Recipes

perks.name: Efficient Processing

perks.name: Concentrated Loads

perks.name: Excavator

perks.name: Veinmaster

perks.name: Mineral Refiner

perks.description: +10% eligible natural-deposit yield and another -10% mining stamina cost.
